cover_section.css: .s-cover_section{position:relative;min-height:812px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:28px;background:#ffd9e8;overflow:hidden}.s-cover_section__shape{position:absolute;border-radius:50%}.s-cover_section__shape--a{width:380px;height:380px;background:#b9e6ff;left:-130px;top:-100px}.s-cover_section__shape--b{width:320px;height:320px;background:#ffe26f;right:-90px;bottom:-70px}.s-cover_section__card{position:relative;z-index:2;width:min(900px,100%);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;background:#fffaf3;border:3px solid #5046a8;border-radius:30px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:14px 14px 0 #5046a8}.s-cover_section img{width:100%;height:620px;object-fit:cover}.s-cover_section__copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:42px}.s-cover_section span{font:700 .72rem var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.17em;color:#ff6b6b}.s-cover_section h1{font:700 clamp(3rem,8vw,5.7rem)/.85 var(--font-title);color:#5046a8;margin:28px 0}.s-cover_section button{align-self:flex-start;padding:14px 22px;border:2px solid #5046a8;border-radius:14px;background:#ffe26f;color:#5046a8;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}@media(max-width:650px){.s-cover_section__card{grid-template-columns:1fr}.s-cover_section img{height:390px}.s-cover_section__copy{padding:32px}}

details_section.css: .s-details_section{padding:85px 24px;background:#fffaf3;color:#5046a8}.s-details_section h2{text-align:center;font:700 3rem var(--font-title)}.s-details_section__grid{max-width:880px;margin:40px auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}.s-details_section article{padding:30px 20px;border:3px solid #5046a8;border-radius:24px;box-shadow:7px 7px 0 #5046a8;text-align:center}.s-details_section .pink{background:#ffd9e8}.s-details_section .blue{background:#b9e6ff}.s-details_section .yellow{background:#ffe26f}.s-details_section span{font-size:2rem}.s-details_section small{display:block;margin:15px 0 8px;font:800 .68rem var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.18em}.s-details_section strong{font:700 1.1rem/1.35 var(--font-title)}@media(max-width:650px){.s-details_section__grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

rsvp_section.css: .s-rsvp_section{padding:85px 24px;background:#b9e6ff;color:#5046a8}.s-rsvp_section h2{text-align:center;font:700 3rem var(--font-title)}.s-rsvp_section__lead{text-align:center;margin-top:10px;font:500 .95rem var(--font-body)}.s-rsvp_section__card{max-width:460px;margin:34px auto 0;padding:30px 24px;background:#fffaf3;border:3px solid #5046a8;border-radius:24px;box-shadow:7px 7px 0 #5046a8}.s-rsvp_section label{display:block;margin-bottom:8px;font:800 .68rem var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}.s-rsvp_section select,.s-rsvp_section input,.s-rsvp_section textarea{width:100%;margin-bottom:18px;padding:13px 15px;font:500 .95rem var(--font-body);color:#5046a8;background:#fff;border:3px solid #5046a8;border-radius:14px}.s-rsvp_section select:focus,.s-rsvp_section input:focus{outline:none;border-color:#ff6b6b}.s-rsvp_section button{width:100%;padding:15px;font:800 .8rem var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#5046a8;background:#ffe26f;border:3px solid #5046a8;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #5046a8;cursor:pointer}.s-rsvp_section button:active{transform:translate(2px,2px);box-shadow:2px 2px 0 #5046a8}.s-rsvp_section button:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:default;transform:none}.s-rsvp_section__note{margin-top:14px;text-align:center;font:600 .82rem var(--font-body)}.s-rsvp_section__note.ok{color:#2f9e6d}.s-rsvp_section__note.err{color:#d8452f}@media(max-width:650px){.s-rsvp_section h2{font-size:2.2rem}}

guestbook_section.css: .s-guestbook_section{padding:85px 24px;background:#ffd9e8;color:#5046a8}.s-guestbook_section h2{text-align:center;font:700 3rem var(--font-title)}.s-guestbook_section__card{max-width:460px;margin:34px auto 0;padding:26px 24px;background:#fffaf3;border:3px solid #5046a8;border-radius:24px;box-shadow:7px 7px 0 #5046a8}.s-guestbook_section__from{margin-bottom:14px;font:500 .88rem var(--font-body)}.s-guestbook_section textarea{width:100%;padding:13px 15px;font:500 .95rem var(--font-body);color:#5046a8;background:#fff;border:3px solid #5046a8;border-radius:14px;resize:vertical}.s-guestbook_section textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:#ff6b6b}.s-guestbook_section button{width:100%;margin-top:16px;padding:15px;font:800 .8rem var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#5046a8;background:#ffe26f;border:3px solid #5046a8;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #5046a8;cursor:pointer}.s-guestbook_section button:active{transform:translate(2px,2px);box-shadow:2px 2px 0 #5046a8}.s-guestbook_section button:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:default;transform:none}.s-guestbook_section__note{margin-top:14px;text-align:center;font:600 .82rem var(--font-body)}.s-guestbook_section__note.ok{color:#2f9e6d}.s-guestbook_section__note.err{color:#d8452f}.s-guestbook_section__list{max-width:460px;margin:34px auto 0;padding:0;list-style:none}.s-guestbook_section__item{margin-bottom:16px;padding:20px;background:#fffaf3;border:3px solid #5046a8;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:5px 5px 0 #5046a8}.s-guestbook_section__item strong{display:block;font:700 1.05rem var(--font-title)}.s-guestbook_section__item p{margin:8px 0;font:500 .9rem/1.6 var(--font-body)}.s-guestbook_section__item time{font:600 .7rem var(--font-body);opacity:.65}.s-guestbook_section__empty{padding:22px;text-align:center;font:500 .88rem var(--font-body);border:3px dashed #5046a8;border-radius:20px}@media(max-width:650px){.s-guestbook_section h2{font-size:2.2rem}}
